instructions.question: What emotional attitude does the poster of this Bosnian tweet convey: positive, neutral or negative?
instructions.rule: Neutral is only for texts with no detectable attitude: ads, shop or TV promos, schedules, check-ins, scores and flat headlines. If any tone is present, choose positive or negative even when it is mild. Complaints, tiredness, irritation, criticism of people, cynicism or sarcasm are negative, even when joking. Laughter, smiley banter, flirting, agreement, affection and fun are positive. Headlines take the valence of the event: progress, support or achievement is positive, while crime, scandal, conflict or harm is negative.

neutral.what: Texts with no attitude: commercial ads, TV or event promos, check-ins, scores, plain informational headlines and flat questions.
examples: I'm at Radon Plaza Hotel (Sarajevo, Bosnia)
Bazar će biti održan 30. novembra u Katoličkom školskom centru u Sarajevu (The bazaar will be held on 30 November...)
Termo šolja: Uživajte u omiljenom piću na poslu, kod kuće ili na putu  Pogledajte ponudu (Thermo mug: enjoy your drink... see the offer)
neutral.cues: I'm at, pogledajte ponudu (see the offer), večeras u (tonight at), cijene (prices), I posted, via @YouTube, 2-0
neutral.not_for: Any complaint, sarcasm or criticism is negative. Any laughter, warmth or flirting is positive.

positive.what: Joy, fun, laughter, playful banter, flirting, affection, agreement, praise, wishes, or headlines about progress, support and achievements.
examples: @rooster_62 hahaha tako je! Nema predaje. (hahaha that's right! No surrender.)
zaljubi se u mene, hitno mi je (fall in love with me, it's urgent)
Koja gotiva danas prva dva casa na sekciji, i sad peti nemam ma ee uzivanjeee (What fun today, no fifth class, enjoyment!)
ZAMJENIK VISOKOG PREDSTAVNIKA: SAD ŽELI BIH U NATO-U (Deputy High Representative: US wants BiH in NATO)
positive.cues: haha, :), :D, :P, <3, volim (I love), uživanje (enjoyment), slažem se (I agree), tako je (that's right), hitno mi je (it's urgent), podrška (support)
positive.not_for: Product ads, shop offers and TV programme promos are neutral. Laughing at your own misery or with a curse is negative.

negative.what: Anger, insults, sadness, tiredness, everyday complaints, irritation at people, cynicism, sarcasm, disgust, or headlines about crime, scandal, conflict or harm.
examples: neprospavane noci ++ (sleepless nights)
Ti ljudi koju napadaju druge kad kasne, a kad oni kasne to je sasvim ok. (Those people who attack others for being late, but when they're late it's fine.)
Onaj osjecaj kad ti je sutra ispit, a ti prvi put dolazis u dodir sa skriptom.. (That feeling when your exam is tomorrow and you're seeing the notes for the first time.)
Incident u Trebinju (Incident in Trebinje)
negative.cues: jebem (f***), mrzim (I hate), fuj (yuck), glupan (idiot), povraćaću (I'll vomit), umrem (I'm dying), -_-, :(, tuga (sadness), dosadno (boring), boli (hurts)
negative.not_for: Purely curious or puzzled questions without irritation are neutral. Friendly teasing with smileys is positive.
